title: Track
description: Spatial telemetry for one object over one contiguous time window. Tracks are referenced by events and never rewrite them. Only the pitch kind is in scope for v1.

source.description: Tracks cannot claim human provenance: a human does not produce samples.

clock.description: The time base the samples are expressed in. Frames are never assumed to be evenly spaced.

rate.description: Nominal samples per second. Informational only.

syncErrorMs.description: Measured clock error across cameras, in milliseconds. Absent means unknown.

frame.description: `field` means the canonical coordinate system. `camera:<id>` means uncalibrated 2D image coordinates.

sigma.description: Per-axis uncertainty in metres. Required: a point without an error estimate is not a measurement.

fit.description: Derived summary of the samples. Absent when the raw samples are insufficient to fit.

breakIn.description: Horizontal break in metres, positive toward first base.

breakVert.description: Vertical break in metres, positive upward, relative to a gravity-only path.

model.description: Producer identification. Required so that a bad model version is traceable.

rms.description: RMS of the trajectory fit, in metres.
